howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会遵循项目中的 CLAUDE.md 文件指令（如命令、代码风格），并使用“Think step-by-step”等关键词进行深度推理，遇到问题时主动检查日志或重试。
howto.when: 当你在项目根目录创建 CLAUDE.md 文件并填写指南时；或在提示中使用“Think step-by-step”等思考关键词时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow instructions in CLAUDE.md (commands, code style) and use keywords like "Think step-by-step" for deeper reasoning, checking logs or retrying on errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you create a CLAUDE.md file in the project root with guidelines, or when you use thinking keywords such as "Think step-by-step" in your prompt.

say_en.note: Triggers deep reasoning for step-by-step analysis.
Have Claude examine logs to locate bugs.

say_en.text: Read CLAUDE.md first and follow its guidelines.
